column5: The bounded two-relation authority retains two lazy response owners in source order, cancels their one shared statement authority, and closes the first response if the second physical send fails. Complete Go result iteration, paging, memory accounting, warnings, runtime statistics, and intermediate channels remain open.

One process opener admits the two-reader connection as one nonzero session identity and one shutdown lease. Both configured scan plans are lowered and validated before one nonzero statement timestamp is acquired and before either transport sends. The full executor builder, dynamic catalog, transaction snapshot variants, joins, writes, aggregates, partitions, indexes, and non-BIGINT types remain open.

Two table-bound transports are opened once from one process factory and reused across statements; each executes the existing range, residual Selection, DAG, request, and decoder path at exactly the same supplied snapshot while preserving immutable per-relation table and plan evidence. Partition readers, paging, feedback, virtual columns, index lookup, and complete runtime statistics remain open.
